text: call crt_ingest("bcfp", "user_habitat_classification", path), five pieces wire together runtime: Registry (inst/extdata/crate_registry.csv) — CSV mapping (source, file_name) pair handler function name schema YAML path. crate looks “know file?” . Loaded crt_registry_load(). Schema YAML (inst/extdata/schemas/bcfp/user_habitat_classification.yaml) — declares canonical column shape (names, types, required flags) known upstream variant (column-name set + normalize-function id). Loaded crt_schema_read(). Handler (R/crt_handler_bcfp_user_habitat_classification.R) — one function per (source, file_name). crate matches actual file columns variant’s declared columns (first set-equal match wins), dispatches matched variant_id handler: 2026-04-26-wide → identity passthrough (already canonical) pre-2026-04-26-long → pivot long rows wide canonical, mapping habitat_ind text values integer indicators Validation (crt_schema_validate()) — handler returns, crate checks every column declared required: true schema present. Fails loud listing missing required columns. Type enforcement (crt_schema_apply()) — finally, crate coerces every named column type declared schema (integer, double, string, logical, datetime). Schema YAML single source truth types; handlers don’t encode type knowledge. Without , readr’s defaults leak (integer cols become double, declared strings become Date). Steps 4 5 crt_schema_conform(), crt_ingest() calls rather reimplements — file frame supply get identical treatment. datetime column instant, crate never moves . POSIXct timezone attribute stamped UTC rather converted: several readers return correct UTC instants carrying timezone label, R renders session’s zone read second clock second timezone. Converting “fix” rendering injects real whole-hour error every join downstream. Stamping fixes label, thing wrong. handler made type change transparent example. wide canonical declares spawning rearing integer columns; long upstream habitat_ind text ("t"/"f"). pivot text→integer conversion step long→wide reshape — callers never see either intermediate form. Type enforcement (step 5) catches leaks boundary regardless handler.

title: Apply a schema's canonical type declarations to handler output — crt_schema_apply
text: datetime column means instant, function never changes instant . POSIXct input tzone attribute stamped "UTC", changes rendering nothing else; epoch untouched. distinction whole point type. Several readers return correct UTC instants empty tzone attribute — GeoPackage DATETIME columns read sf case written — R renders Sys.timezone(). UTC-7 machine instant prints seven hours earlier epoch, reads second clock second timezone. Converting "fix" rendering injects real whole-hour error every downstream join; stamping fixes label, ever wrong. inputs: numeric read epoch seconds Date read UTC midnight. Note .POSIXct() silently ignores tz Date, converting system zone instead, goes format() first — west UTC naive call moves day boundary. character parsed ISO 8601 UTC, accepting T separator trailing Z
